name: saratoga-health-demographics-dashboard
description: Local tooling to rebuild clipped tract GeoJSON from Census TIGERweb.

scripts.build:places:nyc: node scripts/merge-places-sources.js --slim --min-year 2020 --tracts data/tracts_union_square_10mi.geojson --out data/PLACES_union_square_10mi.geojson --manifest data/places_manifest_union_square.json data/PLACES__Local_Data_for_Better_Health,_Census_Tract_Data_2020_release_20260511.geojson data/PLACES__Local_Data_for_Better_Health,_Census_Tract_Data_2021_release_20260511.geojson data/PLACES__Local_Data_for_Better_Health,_Census_Tract_Data_2022_release_20260511.geojson data/PLACES__Local_Data_for_Better_Health,_Census_Tract_Data_2023_release_20260511.geojson data/PLACES__Local_Data_for_Better_Health,_Census_Tract_Data_2024_release_20260511.geojson data/PLACES__Local_Data_for_Better_Health,_Census_Tract_Data,_2025_release_20260511.geojson && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('data/PLACES_union_square_10mi.geojson.gz',require('zlib').gzipSync(require('fs').readFileSync('data/PLACES_union_square_10mi.geojson'),{level:9})); console.log('Wrote data/PLACES_union_square_10mi.geojson.gz');"
